rows.text: Dear friend, Clockie is here to serve you today, tick-tock!
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: Why are you acting so strange today?
...Strange... Tick-tock? I see you noticed, my friend...
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: Clockie fell for Boss Stone's wicked scheme and accidentally drank an expired soda, tick-tock...
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: But don't worry, Clockie will pull himself together in no time, tick-tock!
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: Tick-tock? Dreamville is Clockie's home, of course Clockie would be here!
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: My friend, I see you still do not fully understand our beautiful little town?
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: Believe me, just take a little stroll around and you will fall in love, tick-tock!
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: Serve me? But no one else can see you...
...Tick-tock? C—Can't see me? This... Oh dear, my friend, how did you know?
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: I thought that Mr. Soda's "invisibility mint soda" was a special secret just for me!
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: My kind friend, you won't tell the evil Boss Stone about Clockie's secret weapon, will you?
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: I'm happy to see you my dear friend, tick-tock!
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: I hope you have a wonderful time in Dreamville, tick-tock!
rows.speaker: Clockie
